items.title: Presentation: Fixing the AI Infra Scale Problem by Stuffing 1M Sandboxes in a Single Server
items.blurb: Felipe Huici explains how Unikraft achieves millisecond cold boots, stateful scale-to-zero, and extreme density for sandboxing AI workloads.

items.title: Presentation: Platform Engineering in the Age of AI
items.blurb: The panelists explain how platform teams adapt to support AI-assisted engineering, highlighting which capabilities belong in the platform.
